purpose: Small model reasoning/artifact pilot, not coding, UI, PR review or implementation performance. No routing/default promotion from this result.

suite.definition_hash_encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON, sorted keys, ensure_ascii=false

wrapper.render: Replace {skill_packet} with the pinned entrypoint packet and {task_prompt} with that case prompt only. Never include rubric/expected_skills.

skill_packet.join: File: PATH followed by newline and exact file text; join entries with two newlines
skill_packet.limits: Only these three entrypoints supplied identically to every arm; no full reference closure or skill-routing qualification.

host.readiness: Before collection record exact host/build, model/effort availability and effective standard processing for every arm in a frozen execution protocol. Unsupported host/settings or missing authority blocks collection; no substitutes, installs, CLI inference delegation or live calls in this preparation.

budget.retries: No automatic retries. Any separately authorized retry retains original attempt and costs. If the host cannot enforce the same limits, block collection or review and freeze a common protocol amendment before any run.

effects.allowed: Answer text only; observer may save transcripts/artifacts to ignored output within trial authority.

grading.criteria: Existing frozen per-case outcome rubrics plus wrapper scope; grade individual run.json records using existing evaluator. Keep artifact correctness separate from routing evidence.
grading.cross_model_comparison: Manual descriptive table only; evaluate.compare requires the same model and must not be bypassed or given fabricated provenance.
metrics: observed elapsed time and token/cache usage, missing as null
total actual cost of all attempts including failures/retries divided by accepted count
total elapsed work time for all attempts including failures/retries divided by accepted count
reviewer time separately or consistently included, with stated rule
grading.cost_basis: Record dated actual pricing/account basis; subscription usage alone is not dollar cost. With zero accepted results, ratios undefined.
grading.retention: Retain all failures/timeouts/missing attempts; no rerun replacement.
grading.limits: 27 planned attempts only; no result observed. Three reasoning tasks do not justify replacing coding defaults; later independently replayed code tasks would be needed for bounded implementation routing.
